sources.entry: AIEpics - Generates unique and copyright-free poems based on user-entered prompts. #opensource #free

summary.name: AIEpics
summary.one_liner: AIEpics is a free online AI poem generator that writes rhyming poems from user-entered prompts, powered by OpenAI's ChatGPT.
use_cases: Generating a rhyming poem on a chosen subject
Creating poems for commercial or noncommercial use
summary.what_it_does:
AIEpics takes a user-entered prompt or keywords and generates a rhyming poem on that subject. The backend uses OpenAI's ChatGPT model, which the page says was trained on a custom dataset of poems. The page states that generated poems are unique, copyright-free and plagiarism-free, and that users may use them for commercial or noncommercial purposes. The tool is free and requires no login. The page says the tool is licensed under the MIT license.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
notable: Backend uses OpenAI ChatGPT trained on a custom poem dataset
Poems stated to be copyright-free and usable commercially
caveats: The page does not describe limits on usage or output length
Quality and originality claims are the page's own and are not independently verified
